qualification.command: rtk proxy .venv\Scripts\python.exe -X utf8 -m pytest tests/ui_simplification -q -k "not single_current_baseline_sample and not measured_metadata"
qualification.scope: Current deterministic fixture, exact targets, entries relations/pages/related pages, production HTTP wiring and architecture boundary. Excludes original PR-00 measurement. Includes current one-size sample; no latency percentile claim.

behavior: Complete scoped canonical work/session/connection relations are correlated before grouping/counting/pagination; no React first-page inventory.
Sessions without operations, agent-originated handoffs, unassigned work, historical binding and claim identities retain exact provenance.
Attention and results enrich their parent; unrelated retained occurrences remain explicit. Server incidents remain separate from project counts.
Groups, children, sessions, attention and results expose bounded independent GET pagination with server/scope/principal/parent/revision checks.
One read-only UoW, no transcript/event-journal query, no productive effects. Existing operator policy precedes source reads.
Partial or budget-exhausted sources never become exact empty inventories. Unknown result tracking remains unknown.
Production app installs additive entries routes; overview V1 remains available and tested. No-store and strict query validation apply.
limitations: Materialization costs O(N+relationships) within per-source row and global time budgets, not O(page).
One-size SQL/payload assertions do not prove 1/10/100 scaling or p50/p95; UI-022 remains pending.
HTTP/SQLite fixtures do not qualify a native harness, mounted browser, screen reader or comprehension.
Cases spanning browser and HTTP remain NOT_RUN until both levels are exercised.
Starlette emits its existing httpx TestClient deprecation warning.
effects: Additive read projection and routes only; no grants, sessions, ACKs or execution created by reads.
rollback: Revert additive entries integration and restore legacy presentation; existing overview, sessions, setup/receipts and persisted execution state remain compatible.
